message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current USD/GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), the conversion is roughly:

| Currency | Approximate Rate | Equivalent |
|----------|------------------|------------|
| 1 USD    | 0.77 GBP         | –          |
| 20 USD   | –                | **≈ £15.40** |

So, $20 is about £15.4 – £15.5 at a rate of 1 USD ≈ 0.77 GBP.  

**Note:** Exchange rates change constantly due to market conditions, so the exact amount you receive may differ slightly depending on when you convert the money and which service you use. If you need a precise figure for a specific transaction, check a reliable financial news source or your bank’s currency converter at the time of the transfer.
